set.body:
Outcome

Delete the ScalaFIM reduction loop after adopting locus4s-data PartialMap and PartialSurjection aggregation.

Work

- Migrate any real consumers to locus4s.data.Aggregation over representation-neutral Field.
- Preserve undefined-source skipping, empty-target, deterministic order, and owner-check behavior.
- Delete tests that only prove the duplicate implementation and replace them with focused integration tests where ScalaFIM policy is present.
- Remove the Cats dependency from the retiring locus module or build graph if no remaining production consumer requires it.
- Do not retain a convenience extension solely for hypothetical future use.

Acceptance

- There is one aggregation loop, owned by locus4s-data.
- No production ScalaFIM consumer requires IndexedField for aggregation.
- Remaining dependency declarations reflect actual consumers.
- Focused JVM and Scala.js tests verify the integration seam without duplicating upstream laws.
set.title: Remove duplicate ScalaFIM aggregation and Cats-only locus dependency
